user.title: Add a tracked device
user.description: GPS Timeline archives the location history of one entity so it is never purged.

data_description.entity_id: Any entity exposing latitude/longitude attributes, e.g. device_tracker.my_phone or person.alice.
data_description.places_entity: Places integration sensor whose labels are archived alongside the GPS points.
data_description.activity_entity: Sensor whose state describes the current activity, e.g. walking or driving.
data_description.subject_kind: What this device tracks: person, topic, or object.
data_description.subject_name: Name of the subject, e.g. Yacin or Car. Shown as an attribute on the tracker.
data_description.accuracy_threshold: GPS fixes with an accuracy worse than this are ignored. Set to 0 to keep every fix.

corrupt_database.title: GPS Timeline database was corrupted
corrupt_database.description: The GPS Timeline database could not be opened. The corrupt file was moved to `{backup_path}` and a new empty database was created. Location history archived before this point is only available in the backup file.

backfill.name: Backfill history from recorder
backfill.description: Imports existing location history from the Home Assistant recorder database into the GPS Timeline archive.

entity_id.name: Tracker entity
entity_id.description: The entity tracked by GPS Timeline whose history should be imported.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Earliest point to import. Defaults to 10 days before the end time.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: Latest point to import. Defaults to now.
